prompt: Original side-view Chinese mountain fantasy RPG background in 1990s 16-bit pixel art. Wide 16:9 landscape. Draw as at 160×90 logical pixels using 12 flat matte colors, chunky stepped silhouettes, crisp edges, no gradients. One dominant landmark, quiet lower foreground for the engine to place characters. No text, people, monsters, icons, UI, floating platforms, border, or dithering.

scenes.prompt: A split pair of immense jade limestone fingers thrust out of a calm indigo lake. One small ochre pine at left, pale pink dawn sky, a stone shore across the bottom.
A long narrow grassy saddle in side elevation, one bent pine and two vermilion pennants mark its high pass. Distant purple ranges in afternoon light.

scenes.prompt: Sheltered spring on the back of a mossy ridge. A tilted dark timber waterwheel feeds a broad turquoise basin below a slate overhang. Blue morning shade.
A bright turquoise river rounds three pale stepping stones below an apricot cliff wall. A few large blocks of ochre rushes along the bank. Broad horizontal reflections.

scenes.prompt: A naturally eroded circular opening in an ochre cliff forms a single giant wind window. Wind-bent grasses around its foot, through the window a distant blue ridge.
A sturdy ferry jetty with a curved roof, one empty low Chinese ferryboat tied alongside; broad flat calm blue water and a golden evening sky.
